caption_L1: This bar diagram is labeled Price for U.S. coffee from Hawaii and Puerto Rico between 2000/2001 and 2018/2019 (in U.S. dollars per pound). The y-axis measures Year while the x-axis plots Hawaii.
caption_L2L3: The Price of Coffee between 2000 and 2019 had a low point of $2/lb and a high point of $9/lb. The cheapest price was in 2014/15.  The most expensive price was in 2015/16. The price increased between 2000 and 2006.  The price decreased between 2006 and 2009. The price increased between 2009 and 2015. The price collapsed in 2015.  The price slowly increased between 2015 and 2019.
